risks: Specialist retail as low as Rs 390 (Asama essential basket) and Rs 480 (India Handmade box) for smaller pieces; Rs 849 needs a clearly larger 8-9 in basket, ideally with lid, or the price is not credible
Supplier cost is for an unspecified size with MOQ 50; single-piece drop-ship not confirmed, and a bigger basket may cost more

Overlap check: cane and jute baskets were dropped and a sabai grass basket set (2026-10-22) is NEEDS_INFO; water hyacinth is a different fibre but the same use, so the reviewer should decide whether it repeats a failed line

Volumetric weight: a rigid 8-9 in basket packed about 25 x 25 x 22 cm is about 2.75 kg volumetric (/5000), over the 2 kg limit; only a basket that packs at about 22 x 22 x 20 cm or smaller (or is collapsible/nestable) stays le_2kg; needs packed dimensions
Natural fibre can grow mould in humid storage or transit; ask the supplier about drying/treatment; no 'eco/organic' claims without evidence
Supplier in Assam, so website-only under docs/05
GST assumed 5% (HSN 4602 basketwork of vegetable materials); CA to confirm

review.notes: No hard-rule breach on paper and no Amazon.in/Flipkart/Meesho water hyacinth basket price found on 2026-11-24, so Rs 849 is neither undercut nor validated; margin is 43.6% at Rs 190 but fails from about Rs 300 cost (29.4%) and at Rs 649 (27.7%). Not approvable: the only cost is an unsized MOQ-50 IndiaMART listing (about Rs 9,500 stock, not drop-ship), the packed box for an 8-9 in rigid basket is likely over 2 kg volumetric (which would breach max_weight_slab), and it is the same storage-basket use as the dropped cane/jute lines and the still-unresolved sabai basket set, so it needs a single-piece drop-ship quote with exact size and packed carton dimensions within about 22 x 22 x 20 cm before any sample.
